cases.purpose: In a private PID namespace containing only the fixture's processes, argument-less lsof lists every visible process (all /proc PIDs appear) and the descriptor rows of two sacrificial processes holding files, a pipe, a socketpair, a directory and /dev/null match GNU lsof.
cases.oracle: GNU lsof on the same live process set; both outputs are parsed by one Python normaliser keeping the numeric descriptor rows (fd number and path, anonymous objects collapsed) of the fixture's own sacrificial processes, plus, in the private PID namespace, whether every process listed in /proc beforehand appears in the output.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout, stderr and file tree.

files.lsvic.py:
import ctypes, os, signal, socket, subprocess, sys, time
mode, inner = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
specs = [("v1", False), ("v2", False)] if mode == "all" else [("readable", False), ("hidden", True)]
kids = []
for label, dump in specs:
    open(label + ".r", "w").write("x"); open(label + ".w", "w").write("x")
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        if dump:
            ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(4, 0, 0, 0, 0)
        keep = [os.open(label + ".r", os.O_RDONLY), os.open(label + ".w", os.O_WRONLY), os.open(".", os.O_RDONLY)]
        keep += list(os.pipe()) + [s.fileno() for s in socket.socketpair()]
        keep += [os.open("/dev/null", os.O_RDWR)]
        open(label + ".ready", "w").write("1")
        while True:
            time.sleep(1)
    kids.append((label, pid))
for label, _ in kids:
    while not os.path.exists(label + ".ready"):
        time.sleep(0.02)
open("victims.txt", "w").write("".join("%s %d\n" % k for k in kids))
try:
    rc = subprocess.run([os.environ["BASH"], "--noprofile", "--norc", inner]).returncode
finally:
    for _, pid in kids:
        os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL); os.waitpid(pid, 0)
print("helper-exit=%d" % rc)
files.inner.sh:
for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do echo ${p#/proc/}; done > allpids.txt
lsof > out.txt 2>err.txt; echo "lsof status=$?"
/usr/bin/python3 lsnorm.py out.txt victims.txt allpids.txt all
/usr/bin/rm -f out.txt err.txt allpids.txt

cases.script:
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 BASH
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --pid --fork --mount-proc /usr/bin/python3 lsvic.py all inner.sh
echo "ns status=$?"
